text: The freshest pastries I've ever had. Everything tastes homemade, the service is lovely, and the cakes are absolutely beautiful.
name: Pedri J.

text: Every visit feels like the first bite of something new — the sourdough alone is worth the trip.
name: Amelia M.

text: You can taste the difference real ingredients make. My kids ask for cupcakes by name now.
name: Ramy S.

text: The croissants are incredible, and the smell of freshly baked bread makes every visit special. I always leave with something delicious.
name: Daniel K.
